name: ybial-functions
description: Cloud Functions for Your Business in a Link

scripts.deploy:booking-lifecycle: gcloud functions deploy booking-lifecycle --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --no-allow-unauthenticated --entry-point bookingLifecycle --source functions/booking-lifecycle --region us-east1
scripts.deploy:reminder-dispatcher: gcloud functions deploy reminder-dispatcher --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --no-allow-unauthenticated --entry-point reminderDispatcher --source functions/reminder-dispatcher --region us-east1
scripts.deploy:order-lifecycle: gcloud functions deploy order-lifecycle --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --no-allow-unauthenticated --entry-point orderLifecycle --source functions/order-lifecycle --region us-east1
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:booking-lifecycle && npm run deploy:reminder-dispatcher && npm run deploy:order-lifecycle
